summary.text:
Compiled successfully on first attempt. Provide final answer.

Check semantics: first scan with value 0, prev=0 -> no change. Good. P6 prev update at end. Good.

One concern: SHR on DWORD, i INT loop 0..31 fine.

Final answer.

output.arguments:
{"answer": "Implemented FB_Task (Dual-Word Edge Detection) in CODESYS 3.5 ST and compiled successfully (0 errors, 0 warnings) on the first attempt.

Behavior:
- risingBits := value AND NOT prevValue (32-bit complement)
- fallingBits := prevValue AND NOT value
- hasChanged := value <> prevValue
- hasRisingEdges / hasFallingEdges := corresponding mask <> 0
- noOfRisingBits / noOfFallingBits computed by bit-scanning each mask (0..32, USINT)
- prevValue is updated at the end of the body, so it is compared against the pre-scan value (P6) and initialized to DWORD#0 so first-scan nonzero bits raise edges.

Note: this is compile-time validation only; no PLC functional tests were executed."}
